core_obligations: Algebraicity: the equivalence expressing the inertia and the relative inertia as self fibre products of the respective diagonals presents both as algebraic stacks (proof lines 1238-1246)

Absolute case: for a morphism from a test scheme given by an object, the pullback of the inertia is the space of automorphisms of that object, which is locally of finite type over the test object, so the inertia morphism is representable and locally of finite type (proof lines 1247-1260)

Relative case: the pullback of the relative inertia sits in a diagram of two fibre squares whose left vertical arrow is a morphism of isomorphism spaces locally of finite type over the test object, so the pullback is an algebraic space locally of finite type over the test object and the relative inertia morphism is representable and locally of finite type (proof lines 1261-1288)
proof_roadmap: 由 Categories 的等价，I_X 与 I_{X/Y} 分别是 Δ 的自纤维积 ⇒ 都是代数栈。
T → X 由对象 x 给出时，I_X 的拉回是 Isom_X(x,x)，它是在 T 上局部有限型的代数空间 ⇒ I_X → X 可表示且局部有限型。
相对情形：I_{X/Y} 的拉回由两个同构空间的双方块给出，左垂直箭头局部有限型 ⇒ K 是代数空间且 K → T 局部有限型。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that the inertia stack of an algebraic stack, and the relative inertia of a morphism of algebraic stacks, are algebraic stacks whose morphisms to the source are representable by algebraic spaces and locally of finite type (author lemma at source lines 1219-1236, label lemma-inertia). The proof (source lines 1238-1289) obtains algebraicity from the description of the inertia as a self fibre product of the diagonal, computes the pullback of the inertia along a test object as the automorphism space of that object, and treats the relative case by a second fibre product diagram involving two isomorphism spaces (proof lines 1238-1288). The two fibre product descriptions and the reduction to automorphism spaces are the content. H3.
